Spatial Desktop is an independent interface experiment and is not affiliated with or endorsed by these organizations. Its application and game interfaces are local simulations.

Prototype screenshot dates and sources remain in the capture credits. Third-party content visible inside a screenshot is outside the grant for the contributors’ original work.

Three unused historical bitmap wallpaper files have no recorded source or asset license. They are excluded from the new grants. The full third-party notices list those paths, original project illustrations, development dependencies and other exceptions.

No trademark rights are granted by the project’s copyright licenses.
